title: Board View groups work orders by lead technician and opens one
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin (can edit work orders, sees financial data), viewport 1024 px or wider
The admin's saved Work Orders view is reset over the API: All tab, no filters, no search, display List, no Board View layout keys
A throwaway customer with a unique name and no pinned note, with one vehicle; seeding is pinned to the browser's current location
Two eligible technicians A and B at this location (Technician role, active, clockable), resolved over the API
Four work orders for that customer, each with one line: two with lead technician A, one with lead technician B, one with no lead
More technician columns than fit the viewport

custom_steps_separated.content: Open /workorders and pick Board View from the display switcher
custom_steps_separated.expected: Board View loads with the Unassigned column first, outside the scrolling technician columns

custom_steps_separated.content: Search for the unique customer name
custom_steps_separated.expected: The Unassigned header count reads 1, and the column holds the unassigned work order
The Unassigned column does not move

custom_steps_separated.content: Bring technician A's column into view
custom_steps_separated.expected: The header shows A's name and a count of 2. Both of A's work orders are cards there, each showing its work order number and the customer name

custom_steps_separated.content: Bring technician B's column into view
custom_steps_separated.expected: The header shows B's name and a count of 1, with B's work order as its card

custom_steps_separated.content: Click the unassigned work order's card, away from its more-actions control
custom_steps_separated.expected:
That work order opens

Board View places real work orders in their lead technician's column after a fixed Unassigned column, the header counts match the cards, and clicking a card opens that work order
